# `if`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

If `expr1` evaluates to true, then returns `expr2`; otherwise returns `expr3`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
if(expr1, expr2, expr3)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `conditional_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- if, example 1
> SELECT if(1 < 2, 'a', 'b');
a
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
